senses.gloss: to stamp; (denom. of רֶכֶס) to make a ceiling of cement (v. מַעֲזִיבָה). Y’lamd. beg., quot. in Ar. אימתי ר׳ הקב״ה וכ׳ when did God form his upper stories with water as cement, v. רֶכֶס.—[b. h. רכס to fasten.]
to stamp; esp. (of beasts) to pass over wetted grain; to husk (differ. fr. דּוּשׁ).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 89b">B. Mets. 89ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>פרות המְרַכְּסוֹת בתבואה והדשות וכ׳</he> when cows stamp (secular) grain, or thresh corn of T’rumah &c.

senses.gloss: to cause to stamp, let (beasts) stamp. Tosef. ib. VIII, 10 המַרְכִּיס ed. Zuck. (Var. המְרַכֵּס Pi.); Y. Ter. IX, beg. 46ᶜ המרכין (corr. acc.).
